segments.text: The Protagonist of the story. Orimi Kouki starts out as an ordinary high school student who has an encounter with a meteor right after his class ended. But before he could do anything, he was suddenly transported into another world.

Not only was the sudden transportation shocking enough, but also the sudden presence of magic arts confused him at first. He was later found out as having magical powers that are very unique to this new world.

What Kouki experience in Sorceress route and Alive route early half is precognition like situation but in condition before he birth with physical body in this world. His memory as high school student is copied memory from "original Orimi Kouki" and transferred to another world experience is his first time birth into this world using physical body and completed future simulating. But what he experience in soul world stored in his real physical body and recognize as memory too. Conversely his precog and loop sensation that come with headache and dizziness means that he fail to find ideal future in soul world and return to his ideal save point in addition he can't change his ideal save point as he like until he experience what he must experience in that possibility no matter what. his simulation (progressive precog and loop) will ended at the scheduled time but in the reality he awake "more early" than what scheduled first and from that time the real scenario of Alive route was started in addition his first contact with Akina Sword's stone make Akina remember her previous life too.
現代日本でごく普通の日常を送っていた青年。
ゲーム全般が好きで、特にFPSが得意。
いきなり見知らぬ世界に飛ばされてもまったく落ち込まない程度には前向き。
逆境への適応力が非常に高い。
魔力が序列を決める世界で、未知の力に目覚めることを期待したものの、まったく魔法は使えなかった。
エーリュシオ領の貴族・ランドール家の一人娘。
行動派のリーダー気質で、エーリュシオ代表レイヴチームのリーダーを務めている。
まっすぐな性格なのは良いことなのだが、のめり込むと視野が狭くなりがち。いつもは明るく快活だが、対主人公限定でなかなか素直になれない一面も見せる。
愛用のホウキは、炎の大剣『プロメテウス』。
魔法も使える彼女だが、レイヴでは剣が届く距離での接近戦闘を得意とする。

segments.text: She is the true heroine of the game.

She is actually Kouki's old childhood friend, 星原 美由紀 / Hoshihara Miyuki who gained immortality as side effect after she picked up Mother Stone broken piece and slowly fuse in her body later. With the passage of time and living alone for a long time she was corrupted by Mother Stone and ended up going crazy doing inhuman acts without a doubt and only to "spend her free time"'. Her actual magic is not attack type but brainwash using light particle. With it she hide from other doubt about her youth appearance. In some time she become queen and show or hide her identity on a whim. Later she can reincarnate properly after Mother Stone in her body destroyed by Kouki and Akina.
